rows.commentary: 5.1: Mohammad Sayyam tests Kawser Ahmed early, who merely nudges the ball straight to mid-on.
5.2: Mohammad Sayyam strikes a massive blow in this knockout clash as Kawser Ahmed plays a half-hearted drive, dragging an inside edge crashing onto his stumps to leave Bangladesh two down.
5.3: Mohammad Sayyam hits a nagging short of a length outside off, prompting Md Farid Hasan Faysal to steer it quietly toward backward point.
5.4: Mohammad Sayyam angles a tight delivery in around off, catching an inside edge off Md Farid Hasan Faysal's bat that thuds directly into the pads.
5.5: Mohammad Sayyam overpitches on off stump, and Md Farid Hasan Faysal punishes it with a magnificent straight drive that rockets past the non-striker to the boundary.
5.6: Mohammad Sayyam spears a wide delivery across the right-hander, leaving Md Farid Hasan Faysal to watch it sail past safely.
6.1: Ali Raza probes the surface with a back of a length delivery, anchored securely as Abdullah Al Muhi presents a straight bat down the pitch.
6.2: Ali Raza drifts onto the pads, allowing Abdullah Al Muhi to glance it cleanly away toward fine leg for a single.
6.3: Ali Raza attacks the channel on a length, nudged smoothly into the off side toward extra cover by Md Farid Hasan Faysal.
6.4: Ali Raza tests the line again, met by soft hands as Farid Hasan Faysal deadens the ball securely into the off-side.
6.5: Ali Raza targets the hip region, clipped with pristine timing through square leg by Faysal for a comfortable couple.
6.6: Ali Raza hurries a short delivery past the bat, catching an inside edge that races past the stumps and eludes the fine leg fielder to reach the boundary.
7.1: Mohammad Sayyam oversteps the margin with a short of a length offering, ruthlessly crunched through cover-point by the batsman for a sublime boundary.
7.2: Mohammad Sayyam bowls back of a length, picked early and dispatched with sublime wrists over deep square leg for a maximum by Abdullah Al Muhi.
7.3: Mohammad Sayyam darts one in short at the hips, easily clipped toward midwicket as Abdullah Al Muhi rotates the strike.
7.4: Mohammad Sayyam pitches it fuller around off, driven with authority straight to the fielder at mid-off by Farid Hasan Faysal.
7.5: Mohammad Sayyam serves it up again, driven firmly to the left of wide mid-off where the fielder agilely cuts it off for a single.
7.6: Mohammad Sayyam drops it short, pulled firmly along the turf toward deep square leg to wrap up the over.
17.6: Hasnain Abbas Dar drops it a fraction fuller around off, allowing Abdullah Al Muhi to nudge it towards mid-off and scamper across for a sharp single.
18.1: Rizwanullah slides one full into the arc, and Abdullah Al Muhi stands tall to punch it straight down the ground, holding his picturesque pose as the ball races past the bowler.
18.2: Short and targeting the outer channel, Abdullah Al Muhi swivels on the pull, top-edging it cleanly over the keeper's head to bring up a hard-fought fifty.
18.3: Rizwanullah dangles a full delivery outside off, tempting Abdullah Al Muhi into a flashy drive that catches the outside edge, allowing Hamza Zahoor to safely pouch the catch behind the stumps.
18.4: Rizwanullah angles a fuller delivery outside off past Rakibul Hossan's flashing blade, drawing a loud caught-behind appeal that is immediately waved away by the umpire.
18.5: Rizwanullah pitches it on a length at the stumps, and Rakibul Hossan solidly defends it into the cover region.
18.6: Rizwanullah tosses it full and wide outside off, drawing Rakibul Hossan into an exploratory poke that beats the outside edge entirely.
19.1: Hasnain Abbas Dar digs it in short, permitting All Rafi to swivel and pull the delivery away toward the mid-wicket boundary for a single.
19.2: Hasnain Abbas Dar targets the stumps with a delivery that stays noticeably low, safely nudged away by Rakibul Hossan toward mid-wicket.
19.3: Hasnain Abbas Dar induces a flashing edge as Rakibul Hossan reaches away from his body, racing down to third man and bringing up the team's century.
19.4: Hasnain Abbas Dar fires one across the channel outside off that skids through low, eluding All Rafi's desperate attempted cut shot.
19.5: Hasnain Abbas Dar goes back of a length around middle and leg, giving All Rafi enough time to read the trajectory and launch it majestically over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
19.6: Hasnain Abbas Dar drops it on a good length around middle and leg as All Rafi clears his front leg to heave it fiercely through mid-wicket for a boundary, capping off a twelve-run over.
20.1: Rizwanullah targets a length on off stump, allowing Rakibul Hossan to guide the ball down to third man for a single.
20.2: Rizwanullah delivers a fuller ball around off, which All Rafi simply pushes toward the mid-off fielder.
20.3: Rizwanullah strikes as All Rafi chips it straight back to claim his third wicket of the innings, securing a caught and bowled dismissal that ends Rafi's knock at twenty.
29.1: Ahmed Hussain loops it up invitingly, and Rakibul Hossan presents a straight bat to return it safely to the bowler.
29.2: Rakibul Hossan crouches low to sweep it fine, forcing a frantic chase and sliding recovery by the fielder to restrict it to two.
29.3: Ahmed Hussain offers more flight, allowing Rakibul Hossan to punch the ball cleanly into the deep cover region for a single.
29.4: Sheikh Atiqur Rahman jams down hard on a delivery that is too full, sending it straight toward mid-wicket.
29.5: Sheikh Atiqur Rahman shifts across to glance a flatter delivery sliding down leg, missing as it whispers past the thigh pad to the keeper.
29.6: Ahmed Hussain spears it onto the stumps, and Sheikh Atiqur Rahman dead-bats it right back from whence it came.
30.1: Rakibul Hossan flashes hard at a wide short ball, slicing it into the turf just shy of deep third man.
30.2: Rizwanullah strikes with a fierce short delivery as Rakibul Hossan feathers a top-edge through to Hamza Zahoor, sealing a magnificent semi-final five-wicket haul.
30.3: Tafiul Alam Tamim gets off the mark instantly, working an angling delivery off his pads down to mid-wicket for a comfortable single.
30.4: Rizwanullah digs it in short with venom, prompting Sheikh Atiqur Rahman to duck underneath and let the ball sail safely to the keeper.
30.5: Sheikh Atiqur Rahman plays a watchful back-of-a-length stroke outside off, patting the ball down toward the cover fielder.
30.6: Rizwanullah bangs another short one outside off, which Sheikh Atiqur Rahman hops back to block down into the off-side.
31.1: Ahmed Hussain loops it up nicely, drawing Tafiul Alam Tamim into a heave that catches a hurried inside edge trickling away to short fine leg.
31.2: Ahmed Hussain slips in a clever googly that Tafiul Alam Tamim fails to read, deflecting off the inside edge straight into the pad.

31.3: Ahmed Hussain floats another delivery that Tafiul Alam Tamim pushes weakly inside-edge, allowing a single as the fielder from slip intercepts near short fine leg but spills the chance to restrict the run.

31.4: Ahmed Hussain outsmarts Sheikh Atiqur Rahman as the batter dances down the track for a massive blow, misses completely, and leaves Hamza Zahoor ample time to whip off the bails for a sharp stumping.
3.4: Sheikh Atiqur Rahman drops it back of a length, allowing Hayam Khan to work it toward mid-wicket for a single.
3.5: Sheikh Atiqur Rahman drifts onto the pads, nudged smoothly toward long leg for a brisk single by Usman Khan.
3.6: Sheikh Atiqur Rahman spears across a short of length delivery, which Hayam Khan guides off the back foot to point.
4.1: Tafiul Alam Tamim lands one on a length outside off, probing the corridor and leaving Usman Khan clutching at thin air.
4.2: Usman Khan dances down the track to loft Tafiul Alam Tamim, but the ball stalls in the outfield after a moment of mutual ball-watching yields just one.
4.3: Tafiul Alam Tamim serves up a fuller length, and Hayam Khan stays leg-side to pat it down securely to mid-off.
4.4: Tafiul Alam Tamim bangs it in short, and Hayam Khan accepts the invitation with a thunderous pull over deep square for six.
4.5: Tafiul Alam Tamim angles it onto the pads, easily nudged down toward short fine leg by Hayam Khan.
4.6: Hayam Khan reaches away from his body to drive Tafiul Alam Tamim, only to chop an inside edge directly onto his pads.
5.1: Sheikh Atiqur Rahman keeps it tight as Usman Khan stays leg-side to stab the ball firmly into the off-side.
5.2: Sheikh Atiqur Rahman finds the pads once more, allowing Usman Khan to tickle it down to fine leg for a single.
5.3: Sheikh Atiqur Rahman delivers back of a length angled across, and Hayam Khan stabs it cleanly down into the off-side.
5.4: Sheikh Atiqur Rahman comes from round the wicket, angling it in as Hayam Khan steps firmly behind the line to block it towards cover.
5.5: Sheikh Atiqur Rahman persists, and Hayam Khan hangs back quietly, stabbing the ball down into the cover region.
5.6: Sheikh Atiqur Rahman drops it short and wide, allowing Hayam Khan to pounce and carve it past point all the way to the third man boundary for four.
6.1: Rubay Islam Rizon targets the channel outside off with a back-of-a-length delivery, safely patted down toward point by Usman Khan.
6.2: Rubay Islam Rizon offers a fuller length on the pads, neatly clipped away toward mid-wicket for a single by Usman Khan.
6.3: Rubay Islam Rizon serves up width and length, and Hayam Khan firmly slaps it straight to the fielder at point.
6.4: Rubay Islam Rizon digs it in short outside off, with Hayam Khan stabbing the bouncing ball down toward point.
6.5: Rubay Islam Rizon is punished as Hayam Khan dispatches the ball away to the deep backward point fence for four.
18.6: Robiul Hasan Anik hurls it down, and Hayam Khan creates room to punch it firmly toward deep cover for a single.
19.1: Rakibul Hossan floats it up, and Hayam Khan marches down the track to loft it into the vacant space wide of long-off for one.
19.2: Rakibul Hossan delivers, and Usman Khan drills it straight down to long-off to rotate the strike.
19.3: Rakibul Hossan slides one down the leg side past the marker line as Hayam Khan misses his intended paddle sweep.
19.4: Rakibul Hossan offers a fuller length, and Hayam Khan clips it crisply toward the mid-wicket fielder.
19.5: Rakibul Hossan fires a flatter delivery outside off, and Hayam Khan punches it straight to the man stationed at cover.
19.6: Rakibul Hossan tosses it up, and Hayam Khan hangs back to drive it to long-on, leaving just 18 runs required for victory.
20.1: Robiul Hasan Anik pitches it up, allowing Hayam Khan to retreat and tap it down the ground to long-on for a single.
20.2: Robiul Hasan Anik tosses one onto the stumps, which Usman Khan sweeps firmly away toward deep square leg.
20.3: Robiul Hasan Anik drops it short, skidding past Hayam Khan's attempted pull and striking the wicketkeeper painfully on the knee to bring out the physio.
20.4: Robiul Hasan Anik strikes as Hayam Khan pokes tentatively forward, kissing the outside edge through to Farid Hasan Faysal behind the stumps to finally snap the resistance.
20.5: Robiul Hasan Anik serves up a tossed-up delivery, and Abdul Qadir solidly blocks it behind the line.
20.6: Robiul Hasan Anik delivers to Abdul Qadir, who stays back in his crease and guides the ball toward long-on to comfortably pick up a single.
21.1: Rakibul Hossan drops it up to Abdul Qadir, who dances down the track and absolutely launches the ball high over the long-off boundary for a massive six.
21.2: Rakibul Hossan bamboozles Abdul Qadir with a vicious leg break that dips sharply, grips the surface, and spins past the outside edge.
21.3: Rakibul Hossan floats this delivery up to Abdul Qadir, who presents the full face of the bat and drives it securely down to long-on for one.
21.4: Rakibul Hossan tosses one wide outside off, and Usman Khan gets beneath the trajectory to emphatically drill his shot over the cover region for four.
21.5: Rakibul Hossan serves it up and Usman Khan dispatches the ball over the deep mid-wicket fence to seal the winning runs with authority.

batsmen.name: Ahsan Al Mumin
batsmen.dismissal: c Usman Khan b Hasnain Abbas Dar

batsmen.name: Sheikh Atiqur Rahman
batsmen.dismissal: st Hamza Zahoor b Ahmed Hussain

batsmen.name: Hayam Khan
batsmen.dismissal: c Farid Hasan Faysal b Robiul Hasan Anik

summary.text: Pakistan U19 won by 9 wkts. BANU19 made 138-10, Abdullah Al Muhi top-scoring with 50 off 45 balls; Rizwanullah took 5 for 30. PAKU19 made 141-1, Hayam Khan top-scoring with 69 off 72 balls; Robiul Hasan Anik took 1 for 22.
